notes.title: 《剑魄》第二章内容 解禁！（The second chapter of JianPo is unblocked!）
notes.content:
首章内容涉及到的：
1：全面更新光影效果

2：优化角色的操作手感，部分老角色老剑核进行了手感优化
      清霜剑新增冲刺斩，玄霄后摇削弱，云雀内息调整
      修复了剑核动画卡住相关已知的所有bug。

3:  新增重大模块：角色的升级系统已经开发完毕。
     现在剑体升级后可以通过道具，或者npc进行分支选择，每个分支有不同的属性强化，达到相应等级可以解 
     锁强力的被动buff效果。同时可以通过剑骨进行最直接全面的属性提升。等级总体上限将突破300级，大家 
     可以随意发挥自己的想象进行角色流派的构建。

4：引导道具罗盘的操作得到了进一步优化，现在可以直接装备上快速使用，来快速寻脉。默认直接寻脉上一次搜索的道具，按住使用键，可以切换其他道具进行寻脉。

第二章内容：
1：全新的一段流程，全新的敌人和boss等待你来探索和击败

2：新关卡有2个新剑核以及两个全新的变身状态，更多样，更震撼强大的boss。

3：第二章流程末尾加入了无尽试炼模式的通天塔，可以快速验证等级build的实用性，同时去挑战正常流程中遇不到的更高级别的战斗

（由于更新内容太过庞大，细节调整太过庞杂在此就不一一罗列，仅针对大的模块对大家进行介绍，更多内容还请大家在游戏中体验哦！）
The first chapter covers.
1: Comprehensive update of light and shadow effects

2: Optimization of the feel of the operation of the character, some of the old characters old sword nucleus for the feel optimization
      Clear Frost Sword added sprint chop, Xuanxiao rear swing weakened, Lark internal breath adjusted
      Fixed all known bugs related to sword nucleus animation jamming.

3: Major new module added: The upgrade system for characters has been developed.
     Now the sword body can be upgraded through props, or npc for branching options, each branch has different attribute enhancements, and reaching the corresponding level can unlock powerful passive buff effects. 
     Each branch has different attribute enhancements, and reaching the corresponding level will unlock powerful passive buff effects. At the same time, the most direct and comprehensive attribute enhancements can be made through the sword bone. The overall level cap will be exceeded at 300. 
     You are free to use your own imagination to build your character's style.

4: The operation of the compass has been further optimised, and can now be used directly on the equipment to quickly search for a pulse. The default is to search for the last searched prop directly, and by holding down the use button, you can switch to another prop for pulse searching.

Chapter 2 Contents.
1: A brand new section of the flow with new enemies and bosses waiting for you to explore and defeat

2: The new level has 2 new sword cores and 2 new transformation states, with more diverse and powerful bosses.

3: The Endless Trial mode Tower has been added at the end of the second chapter, allowing you to quickly verify the usefulness of the level builds and challenge yourself to higher level battles that you would not encounter in the normal flow.

(As the update is too huge, the details are too complicated to be listed here, only for the big modules to introduce to you, more content please experience in the game!

notes.title: An update with little movement but a qualitative change in experience
notes.content:
1: Players can now change the game difficulty directly in the game at any time

2：New "pulse search" props: spirit compass. When you get this prop, all the props will unlock a "pulse search" function. Players can use this function to find the address of the scene with the origin of the Tao. At the same time, the compass can be used to locate the location of the archive point.

5：Added operation port to the "elevator" of the west mountain gate, now the elevator is not nearby, you can also sit with the flag operation port, summoned to the elevator.

notes.title: A larger update in 2020
notes.content:
New and adjustment
1: Replace and adjust the UI distribution of the main menu interface, and regularize the screen settings into one button.
2: True Immortal difficulty is locked by default and will be unlocked only after there is a pass archive.
3: New attack can automatically lock the function, you can choose to close in the game preferences.
4: New frame rate cap selection option, but at present for stability is still the actual maximum lock at 60.
5: Further adjust the loading speed settings to increase the stability of the game.
6: The key prompt in the game can be replaced in real time according to the settings.
7: Key binding page of the key name can be read.
8: Added a new section of light skill practice level in the guide level.
9：Changed the logic of using sword manuals and books, books can be transferred to special training levels.
10: Changed the pickup location of sword manuals and books.
11: Spiritual spring mouth can now be directly teleported without having to enter the sea of consciousness.
12: Raised the lower limit of player attack power under the influence of inner breath, and the overall damage lower limit was raised.
13: Optimized the stability of the player's character taking hits
14: Added a new magic treasure in the book "The Beginning of Enlightenment".
15: The name of the current scene is displayed after entering the game or teleporting.
16: The volume fog display of the guide level was adjusted, and the overall visibility of light and darkness was improved

Problem fixes.
1: Fixed the problem that the character was knocked down and could not get up quickly with dodge.
2: Fixed the problem that the boss of the guide level would get stuck and could not move
3: Fixed the problem that some scene models collide inaccurately
4: Fixed the problem of "creeping" caused by too obvious changes in terrain subdivision in some locations
5: Fixed the stability of the character air hit
6: Fixed the problem that the player would get stuck in the action when hit with a small probability.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: The long-awaited part of the update has been completed
notes.content:
1: new transfer function
Players can now choose any previously unlocked Checkpoints（灵泉口LingQuanKou） in the inner space（识海Shi Hai） as their exit adventures.
However, because this part of the storage function was not done before, the archive that has been played for a period of time is not unlocked. Therefore
But also to trouble the players again to unlock a time, can save the unlock state!

2: Name and background of the Checkpoints（灵泉LingQuan）
The different locations of the Checkpoints（灵泉LingQuan） have their own names, and some background Settings have been added.

3: enhance the effect of the guide item "Po Jiu De Chun Yang Di Zi Shou Ji"(破旧的纯阳弟子手记)
A more targeted map-like page was added to the script.
When the script is opened, the destination in the scene will be displayed, and it will still be displayed some time after the script is closed.

4: MORTAL(凡人FanRen), TRUE SPIRIT（真灵ZhenLing）, TRUE GOLD（真仙ZhenXian）mode content adjustment
Reduced the tooltip that will show the target position on the screen when the tooltip is turned on under TRUE SPIRIT. This tooltip will only appear in MORTAL mode.
There will no longer be any guidance in TRUE GOLD mode.
All guide content will remain in mortal mode.

5: updated the introduction text under the mode selection interface


6: BirdBoss(云雀 YunQue) enhancement in true fairy mode
In  TRUE GOLD mode, the 云雀YunQue's darts are increased from 4 to 6.
In  TRUE GOLD mode, the 云雀YunQue's air shock range will be restored to the previous range (radius increased).

7: fixed 云雀YunQue's animation issue
云雀YunQue will no longer be "tired" and will stop and wait for players to attack.

8: added Loading interface introduction content richness
Currently there are 7 pages of loading page, which will be expanded in the future.

Have fun ~
